Southwest General green room sandwiches.d: Egg salad with cress, and cucumber with cream cheese, on soft white bread. Crusts off, cut in triangles.

Sandy's audition capsicum and feta dip.n: Roasted red pepper and feta dip
Sandy's audition capsicum and feta dip.d: Charred under the broiler, peeled, then blended smooth with feta, thick yogurt, garlic, chili flakes and olive oil. Seeded crackers.

Les's farm roast chicken.d: Salted the night before, with lemon zest, thyme and butter under the skin. Carved, with potatoes cooked in the pan.

Strawberry shortcake.d: Cream biscuits baked this morning, split and filled with sugared berries and soft whipped cream.

Dorothy Michaels' Russian caravan tea.d: Brewed strong and black, poured into glasses, with sliced lemon and cherry preserves to stir in.
Dorothy Michaels' Russian caravan tea.note: Poured all day in the Rehearsal Hall.
